cues.text: Cover, frame one: a house at night with one kitchen window lit, the plate CLOSED AT FIVE / NOW WHAT?, tag EXAMPLE, and the source strip ServiceTitan State of the Trades. At 0.6 s a cut in close to her phone: CALLING YOUR SHOP, 6:50 PM, the ring dots counting. At 2.4 s back out wide: Snow beside the lit window, the phone ringing (EXAMPLE). On "four" four ring marks pop one by one; on "closed" a voicemail bubble drops in, "We're closed.", and CLOSED stamps.

ServiceTitan's own line on a card, typed on, with its label (Share of home HVAC calls outside business hours) and tag (2025 data, participating customers' residential HVAC calls, read Nov 7, 2026; off-hours: weekdays before 8 am or after 5 pm, plus weekends). On "one in ten" the gauge: the needle swings to 9.8% (data.js), label OCTOBER: LOWEST MONTH.

The send card, a phone's voicemail settings screen: FOR YOUR OFFICE MANAGER / AFTER-HOURS MESSAGE and the new message in a box, EXAMPLE. It goes up whole, then holds still while the voice reads it; "call back" and "text" sweep on their words.

Versus: CLOSED MESSAGE on the left, NEW MESSAGE on the right, no stats and no winner. Under the left on "no next step": NO NEXT STEP; under the right on "does": TEXT US. (Our own two messages, not data.)
The chat in the truck: a notification drops in, then her text slides up: furnace won't start, no heat, [address] (EXAMPLE). On "details" JOB DETAILS IN slams in the chat area.
Back to the house at night, ten to seven: the phone rings, and this time the bubble reads the new message; on "next" WHAT TO DO NEXT lands. Then the end card with the send line.
